faq.q: Are there official KOF: Legend redeem codes right now?
faq.a: Check the Active codes table on this page. It lists only codes confirmed on official channels, each with a link to the official post. When none are confirmed, the page says Pending official verification.

faq.q: Where do you look for official codes?
faq.a: The official KOF: Legend Discord #gift-code-drops channel, which we follow automatically and check every few minutes. A code is listed only when it appears in an official post there.

faq.q: Why don't you list codes posted on unofficial sites?
faq.a: We list only verifiable official redeem codes. Codes circulating on unofficial sites are unverified and not listed.

faq.q: How do I redeem a code?
faq.a: The exact in-game steps have not been confirmed from official sources. When an official post explains the redeem path, we will add it to the How to redeem section.
